import { Icon, IconButton, type IconName } from "@unicron/ui"
import { MasterDetail, Row } from "./parts"

// A comment that says <Icon name="home" /> and icon="delete" is not code.
export function Toolbar({ open, kind, busy, onClose }: { open: boolean; kind: string; busy: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  return (
    <header className="flex items-center gap-2">
      <Icon name="home" />
      <Icon name='mail' className="size-4" />
      <Icon   name = { "content_copy" }   />
      <Icon name={`inbox`} />
      <Icon name={open ? "keyboard_arrow_up" : "keyboard_arrow_down"} />
      <Icon name={kind === "folder" ? "folder_open" : kind === "search" ? "search" : "description"} tone="muted" />
      <Icon
        name={
          busy
            ? "hourglass_top"
            : "check_circle"
        }
      />
      <Icon name={pick(kind) ?? "help"} />
      <Icon name={(busy && "sync") || "refresh"} />
      <IconButton label="Close" icon="close" onClick={onClose} />
      <IconButton label={open ? "Hide" : "Show"} icon={open ? "visibility_off" : "visibility"} />
      <MasterDetail emptyIcon="stylus_note" emptyLabel="Open a note." />
      <Row glyph="alternate_email" leadingIcon="lock" trailingIcon={busy ? "sync" : undefined} />
      <Icon name="forward" />
      <Icon name="progress_activity" className="animate-spin" />
      {/* Not icons: the same words on other attributes and other elements. */}
      <input type="search" name="search" placeholder="Search" aria-label="close" />
      <Field name="mail" variant="link" data-icon="inline-start" />
      <Glyph name="content_copy" />
      <p>Press add to continue, then close the "search" panel. Don't delete it.</p>
      <p title="home">{t("delete")} {kind === "edit" ? "edit" : "info"}</p>
    </header>
  )
}

function pick(kind: string): IconName | undefined {
  return kind === "mail" ? "mail" : undefined
}
